scripts/build-smto-site.py

Python · Tier B

Build a standalone website wheel with only reviewed public source projections.

Usage

python scripts/build-smto-site.py --output artifacts/smto-site/wheels

Inputs

The content allowlist, site package, requirements and root LICENSE.

Side effects

Creates an isolated temporary setuptools project and one wheel. Selected Manual sections are projected at build time, never hand-maintained copies.

Cleanup

Temporary staging is removed; output wheel belongs to the caller.

@see src/smto_site/content.py

@see packaging/site/requirements.txt
